role: Senior Data Engineer / Power BI Developer - Databricks
responsibilities: Transform complex data into scalable, interactive, and actionable business intelligence solutions.
Manage the full analytics lifecycle, from gathering business requirements and analyzing source data to transforming datasets, developing semantic models, and delivering intuitive dashboards.
Modernize fragmented reporting environments and reduce reliance on spreadsheets and manual processes.
Provide stakeholders with trusted insights for operational and strategic decision-making.
Bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams while taking ownership of data quality, reporting usability, and long-term scalability.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: taking ownership of data quality, reporting usability, and long-term scalability
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: quality, validation, governance, lineage and report performance run through the JD, against a single 'fast-paced' mention buried in preferred qualifications.
evidence.domain_risk: provide stakeholders with trusted insights for operational and strategic decision-making
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate: this is enterprise reporting for business decisions, with no client sector named and no financial, audit or regulatory language.
evidence.data_team_maturity: This individual will help modernize fragmented reporting environments, reduce reliance on spreadsheets and manual processes
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid: Databricks, Snowflake and Power BI are already in place but reporting is 'fragmented' and still spreadsheet-dependent, so the function exists and is being scaled up.
evidence.jd_authorship: The ideal candidate can manage the full analytics lifecycle—from gathering business requirements and analyzing source data to transforming datasets, developing semantic models, and delivering intuitive dashboards.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Mixed: the role narrative is staffing-agency framing ('highly skilled', 'bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams') while all the precision — DAX, row-level security, Delta Lake — sits in the requirements list.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Ability to work cross-functionally with business, analytics, data engineering, and infrastructure teams.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Mixed: the reporting output serves unnamed business stakeholders while the day-to-day partners are analytics, data engineering and infrastructure, with neither side given priority.
evidence.autonomy_level: taking ownership of data quality, reporting usability, and long-term scalability
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mixed: the role owns quality and scalability of the BI layer but delivers against requirements it gathers, and only 'help[s] modernize' the wider reporting estate.
evidence.ai_role: Familiarity with machine learning, predictive analytics, or AI-enabled analytics capabilities.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: None: AI appears once as vague optional familiarity — the candidate is neither asked to use AI coding tools nor to build data that AI systems consume.
evidence.testing_framing: taking ownership of data quality, reporting usability, and long-term scalability
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: data quality is framed as something the candidate takes ownership of in the role summary, beyond the 'data validation' skills listed in requirements.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: provide stakeholders with trusted insights for operational and strategic decision-making
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High: trust is the stated purpose of the role in the overview, and the fear is unreliable spreadsheet-based numbers reaching decision-makers.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: This individual will help modernize fragmented reporting environments, reduce reliance on spreadsheets and manual processes
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Fix_scale: the work is modernizing an existing estate and 'consolidating redundant dashboards', not building a new platform.
evidence.work_arrangement: Location: ALPHARETTA, GA or Roseland, NJ (Hybrid) (Need Local candidates)
evidence.loss_aversion: Trust in reporting is the stated purpose of the role: 'provide stakeholders with trusted insights for operational and strategic decision-making.'
